definitions.explanation: A regularly updated website or web page, typically run by an individual or small group, written in an informal or conversational style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧ブログ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I update my blog every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦ブロガー→ブロガー：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a famous blogger.

notes:
From English "blog" (weblog). Blogs remain popular in Japan, often used for longer-form personal writing, reviews, and hobby content.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ブログ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a blog post
- ブログ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to update a blog
- ブログ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read a blog
- ブログ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}める→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧: to start a blog
- ブログ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧: blog article/post

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ブロガー→ブロガー：noentry⟧: blogger
- ⟦{投稿|とうこう}→投稿：04733_toukou⟧: a post (also used for social media)
- ⟦{記事|きじ}→記事：00227_kiji⟧: article
- ⟦SNS→SNS：05601_esuenuesu⟧: social networking service (the Japanese term for social media)

USAGE:
In Japan, blog platforms like Ameba (⟦アメブロ→アメブロ：noentry⟧) and ⟦はてなブログ→はてなブログ：noentry⟧ have been widely used. Unlike short-form SNS posts, ブログ typically refers to longer written content.
